# Safety and Usability Checklist: Repository Content Studio

**Purpose**: Independent, high-rigor requirements-quality gate for local repository authoring, data integrity, media and complete contributor journeys.
**Created**: 2026-10-21
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by executing the installed `$speckit-checklist` protocol with the parent review assignment as its arguments. No extensions file was present. The setup script resolved the absolute feature directory and canonical template. Scope, audience and depth were explicit, so no clarification questions were needed.
**Review Ownership**: Independent reviewer owns this artifact. The implementation owner must not change its markers.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` approves requirements quality, never implementation completion. All items are initially generated unchecked.

## Requirement completeness and clarity

- [x] CHK001 Are supported entity types, common guided fields and searchable relationship requirements enumerated, with no manual IDs, paths or JSON needed for common creation? [Completeness, Spec FR-002/003]
- [x] CHK002 Is the canonical source layout and deterministic build ownership specified, including migration compatibility and rejection of duplicate authorities? [Clarity, Spec FR-003/004]
- [x] CHK003 Are optional author startup and ordinary read-only startup explicitly distinct, including distributable contents? [Clarity, Spec FR-001/014]
- [x] CHK004 Are allowed repository roots, generated path grammar, Windows reserved names, case collision and symlink/junction boundaries specified? [Coverage, Spec FR-008]
- [x] CHK005 Are Host, Origin, session proof, loopback binding, method, content-type and cross-origin rejection requirements unambiguous? [Completeness, Spec FR-009]
- [x] CHK006 Are private player data, originals, drafts, tokens and recovery-state exclusions explicit for writes, Git review and public packaging? [Coverage, Spec FR-010/011]
- [x] CHK007 Is change preview scoped to author-managed public paths with bounded output and no arbitrary command or Git mutation surface? [Clarity, Spec FR-011; Gap]

## Data integrity and recovery coverage

- [x] CHK008 Is the save atomicity boundary defined across records, media, pack metadata and migration, rather than merely described as transactional? [Clarity, Spec FR-005]
- [x] CHK009 Are crash/restart stages, durable journal ordering, platform durability limits and interrupted-recovery outcomes specified? [Coverage, Spec FR-005; Gap]
- [x] CHK010 Are conflict revisions and stale-tab/external-edit outcomes specified for both save and recovery, preserving unrelated working-tree changes? [Coverage, Spec FR-005]
- [x] CHK011 Are interrupted migration authority and previous-source recovery specified without two editable sources becoming authoritative? [Consistency, Spec FR-004/005]
- [x] CHK012 Are dependency previews and refusal rules defined for record/asset deletion, replacement and renaming? [Coverage, Spec FR-007]
- [x] CHK013 Are validation-before-publication, missing references, duplicate IDs and duplicate JSON keys specified across form, advanced JSON and imports? [Consistency, Spec FR-002/005/012]
- [x] CHK014 Are recovery conflicts actionable and clearly distinguished from safe automatic recovery and an ordinary failed save? [Clarity, Spec FR-005/013]

## Media and capacity requirements

- [x] CHK015 Are supported formats, byte/pixel/dimension budgets, decode integrity, cancellation and resource limits explicitly quantified? [Measurability, Spec FR-006/008/012; Gap]
- [x] CHK016 Are full raster integrity requirements consistent across author uploads, portable imports and build validation without weakening strict PNG validation? [Consistency, Spec FR-006/012/014]
- [x] CHK017 Are crop, optimization, thumbnail and primary/additional image outcomes and derivative metadata explicitly specified? [Completeness, Spec FR-006]
- [x] CHK018 Are deduplication scope, explicit reuse choice, replacement semantics and where-used behavior specified? [Clarity, Spec FR-006/007]
- [x] CHK019 Are rights, attribution, provenance, stable identity, content hash and source-path ownership requirements consistent for originals and derivatives? [Consistency, Spec FR-006]
- [x] CHK020 Are published catalog capacity and portable-import limits independently quantified, with schema/runtime agreement and paged metadata/lazy bytes requirements? [Measurability, Spec FR-012, SC-003]

## Contributor experience and exception coverage

- [x] CHK021 Are loading, empty, failed-validation, expired-session, failed-save and conflict states defined with recovery actions? [Coverage, Spec FR-013]
- [x] CHK022 Are unsaved draft warning/retention rules specified for cancel, pack/record switching, back navigation and asynchronous image operations? [Coverage, Spec Story 3, FR-013]
- [x] CHK023 Are keyboard/focus/status semantics and measurable 320px/390px/desktop/200% text acceptance requirements specified? [Measurability, Spec FR-013, SC-004]
- [x] CHK024 Is the existing browser-private editor explicitly distinguished from repository authoring so save destinations cannot be confused? [Clarity, Spec FR-001/003/010; Gap]
- [x] CHK025 Are new-pack and portable import preview/cancel/version compatibility scenarios included in the same source-of-truth and media safeguards? [Coverage, Spec Story 3, FR-004/012]

## Acceptance criteria and dependencies

- [x] CHK026 Does acceptance explicitly require a browser-created pictured weapon with typed decimal stats/units and linked item/recipe to survive source save, restart, rebuild and fresh checkout without IndexedDB? [Measurability, Spec SC-001]
- [x] CHK027 Are inherited runtime/static routes, actual image/details/maps/portable behaviors, CSP and browser health regressions retained as release gates? [Coverage, Spec FR-014, SC-005]
- [x] CHK028 Are Windows/Linux sandboxed Chromium, Firefox/WebKit functional and independently reviewed Windows/Firefox visual evidence scoped without weakening CSP for screenshot helpers? [Consistency, Spec SC-004/005; Gap]
- [x] CHK029 Are final exact-source review, merge authorization and main CI evidence required before completion claims, separate from hosting and security changes? [Clarity, Spec SC-005, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK030 Are limits of the local threat model and power-loss guarantees explicit without excluding ordinary concurrent external editing? [Clarity, Spec Assumptions, FR-005]

## Notes

Initial generation only; design evaluation follows completion of plan/contracts. `$speckit-implement` reads this gate and must not modify its markers. Implementation tests and visual evidence belong in a separate acceptance record, not these checkboxes. Built-in `requirements.md` remains specify/clarify-owned.

## Independent design evaluation, 2026-10-21

Reviewed completed spec, plan, research, data model, tasks and contracts/authoring.md. CHK002–CHK030 are satisfied by the stated requirements and explicit contracts, including appended recovery/contributor controls and bounded guarantees. This does not assert code exists or passes. CHK001 remains open only because New catalog must generate its immutable ID by default rather than require manual ID entry; an advanced override is acceptable. Initial five design findings were resolved in the contract before implementation.

Final design gate: CHK001 resolved by generated stable namespaced IDs and collision-free keys, with optional advanced override only. All 30 requirements-quality criteria pass. Implementation may proceed after the implementation owner completes the read-only analyze consistency gate. Security, functional, exact-source, fresh-clone and browser/visual acceptance remain unexecuted and required.

## Saved preview addendum requirements

- [x] CHK031 Are saved-record preview identity, source revision/version, missing/deleted record and invalid-query outcomes specified, clearly distinct from unsaved drafts and public build publication? [Clarity, Spec FR-015]
- [x] CHK032 Are preview text/link escaping, same-origin boundaries, validated media/reference lookup, private-state isolation and concurrent-render isolation requirements specified? [Coverage, Spec FR-001/009/010/015]
- [x] CHK033 Does preview acceptance require source changes after Save, no changes after Cancel and a still-read-only public server? [Measurability, Spec FR-015, SC-001]

Generated addendum criteria are unchecked pending final written contract review. Earlier 30-criterion approval remains valid for its scope; preview implementation depends on these new criteria.

Saved-preview design gate: CHK031–CHK033 pass after the written Saved-record preview contract defines saved revision/version, invalid/missing queries, per-call escaped rendering and Cancel semantics. FR-015 implementation/browser evidence remains required, including saved preview refresh after Save and unchanged preview after Cancel.
